# Players: the strongest other power's capital at each location, for its flag
# (gui_modding_guide.md gotcha #15: a country is read through a stored state).
sr_loc_refresh_snapshot = {
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_top_earth ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_top_earth = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_earth value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_second_earth ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_second_earth = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_earth value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ls_cap_earth } remove_variable = sr_ls_cap_earth }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_top_inner ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_top_inner = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_inner value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_second_inner ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_second_inner = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_inner value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ls_cap_inner } remove_variable = sr_ls_cap_inner }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_top_mars ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_top_mars = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_mars value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_second_mars ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_second_mars = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_mars value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ls_cap_mars } remove_variable = sr_ls_cap_mars }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_top_asteroids ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_top_asteroids = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_asteroids value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_second_asteroids ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_second_asteroids = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_asteroids value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ls_cap_asteroids } remove_variable = sr_ls_cap_asteroids }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_top_jupiter ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_top_jupiter = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_jupiter value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_second_jupiter ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_second_jupiter = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_jupiter value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ls_cap_jupiter } remove_variable = sr_ls_cap_jupiter }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_top_saturn ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_top_saturn = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_saturn value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_second_saturn ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_second_saturn = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_saturn value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ls_cap_saturn } remove_variable = sr_ls_cap_saturn }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_top_uranus ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_top_uranus = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_uranus value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_second_uranus ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_second_uranus = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_uranus value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ls_cap_uranus } remove_variable = sr_ls_cap_uranus }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_top_neptune ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_top_neptune = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_neptune value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_second_neptune ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_second_neptune = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_neptune value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ls_cap_neptune } remove_variable = sr_ls_cap_neptune }
	if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_top_kuiper ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_top_kuiper = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_kuiper value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { global_var:sr_loc_second_kuiper ?= { is_country_alive = yes exists = capital NOT = { this = root } } }
		global_var:sr_loc_second_kuiper = { save_temporary_scope_as = sr_ls_power }
		set_variable = { name = sr_ls_cap_kuiper value = scope:sr_ls_power.capital }
	}
	else_if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_ls_cap_kuiper } remove_variable = sr_ls_cap_kuiper }
}

# ===== The AI (design § 14) =====
# A garrison due at a world of ours (design § 9.6): a fleet at Earth with
# marines for it leaves for its location, if none of ours is there or on its
# way; not one closing in on a lunar world (lunar colonization § 8.4). One
# order a month. One due on the Moon, a fleet at Earth lands (owner, 2026-11-24).
sr_fl_ai_send_garrisons = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_loc_garrison_due_earth = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = 1 sr_fl_1_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_1_can_land = yes NOT = { sr_fl_1_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_land_at = { N = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 sr_fl_2_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_2_can_land = yes NOT = { sr_fl_2_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_land_at = { N = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_fl_3_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_3_can_land = yes NOT = { sr_fl_3_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_land_at = { N = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1 sr_fl_4_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_4_can_land = yes NOT = { sr_fl_4_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_land_at = { N = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = 1 sr_fl_5_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_5_can_land = yes NOT = { sr_fl_5_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_land_at = { N = 5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc var:sr_fl_6_loc = 1 sr_fl_6_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_6_can_land = yes NOT = { sr_fl_6_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_land_at = { N = 6 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc var:sr_fl_7_loc = 1 sr_fl_7_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_7_can_land = yes NOT = { sr_fl_7_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_land_at = { N = 7 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc var:sr_fl_8_loc = 1 sr_fl_8_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_8_can_land = yes NOT = { sr_fl_8_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_land_at = { N = 8 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = 1 sr_fl_9_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_9_can_land = yes NOT = { sr_fl_9_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_land_at = { N = 9 }
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_loc_garrison_due_inner = yes NOT = { sr_fl_any_at_or_bound = { CODE = 2 } } }
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc var:sr_fl_1_loc = 1 sr_fl_1_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_1_may_depart_inner = yes NOT = { sr_fl_1_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 1 LOC = inner CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc var:sr_fl_2_loc = 1 sr_fl_2_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_2_may_depart_inner = yes NOT = { sr_fl_2_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 2 LOC = inner CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc var:sr_fl_3_loc = 1 sr_fl_3_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_3_may_depart_inner = yes NOT = { sr_fl_3_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 3 LOC = inner CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc var:sr_fl_4_loc = 1 sr_fl_4_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_4_may_depart_inner = yes NOT = { sr_fl_4_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 4 LOC = inner CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc var:sr_fl_5_loc = 1 sr_fl_5_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_5_may_depart_inner = yes NOT = { sr_fl_5_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 5 LOC = inner CODE = 2 }
		}

			limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc var:sr_fl_9_loc = 1 sr_fl_9_marines_value >= sr_garrison_marines_needed sr_fl_9_may_depart_kuiper = yes NOT = { sr_fl_9_closing_at_earth = yes } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 9 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
		}
	}
}

# A fleet away from Earth with nothing to do there (no garrison due, no world of
# ours under threat, and (6c) no enemy world it is attacking while its fleets
# there are a match for the enemy's) comes home when it can.
sr_fl_ai_home_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc NOT = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 1 } sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_earth = yes }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 2 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_inner = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_inner = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_inner = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 3 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_mars = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_mars = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_mars = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 4 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_asteroids = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_asteroids = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_asteroids = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_asteroids = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 5 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_jupiter = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_jupiter = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_jupiter = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_jupiter = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 6 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_saturn = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_saturn = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_saturn = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_saturn = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 7 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_uranus = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_uranus = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_uranus = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 8 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_neptune = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_neptune = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_neptune = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_neptune = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 9 NOT = { sr_loc_garrison_due_kuiper = yes } NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_kuiper = yes } NOT = { AND = { sr_loc_ai_target_kuiper = yes sr_fl_ai_holds_kuiper = yes } } }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
	}
}

sr_fl_check_target_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target } }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 1 }
		sr_cb_check_target = { N = $N$ KEY = valles_marineris }

	}
}

# Closing in on a free colony begins its price (sr_cb_charge_free).
sr_fl_charge_free_at = {

		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 1 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 2 }

# The target popup's choice (UI pass design § 7; sr_fleet_set_target_sgui): the
# world whose index is scope:pick, then its charge: interdicting, the
# interdiction's price when its holder is a new one; closing in, a free
# colony's. The scripted GUI holds the pick to a world here that the posture
# may take.
sr_fl_set_target_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 1 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = 1 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 2 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 3 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = 3 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 4 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = 4 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 5 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = 5 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 6 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 7 }

	else_if = {

		limit = { scope:pick = 37 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = 37 }

	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 39 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = 39 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:pick = 40 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = 40 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_$N$_posture_value = 4 }
		sr_fl_charge_icpt_at = { N = $N$ }
		sr_icpt_rebuild = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_$N$_posture_value = 3 }
		sr_fl_charge_free_at = { N = $N$ }
	}
}

# The hostile step (Close in's target, sr_fl_set_posture_at): the next hostile
# world at the slot's location after its target (table order), else the first;
# none clears it. At Earth, the lunar worlds (lunar colonization § 8.1). A free
# colony's price only while it closes in.
sr_fl_step_hostile_target_at = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_tgt value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_tgt value = var:sr_fl_$N$_target } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 1 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 35 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = shackleton } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 35 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 36 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = peary } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 36 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 37 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = tranquility } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 37 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 38 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = marius_hills } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 38 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 39 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = daedalus } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 39 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 40 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = imbrium } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 40 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = shackleton } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 35 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = peary } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 36 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = tranquility } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 37 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = marius_hills } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 38 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = daedalus } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 39 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = imbrium } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 40 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 2 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 17 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = venus } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 17 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 18 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mercury } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 18 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = venus } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 17 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = mercury } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 18 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 3 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 1 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 2 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 3 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 3 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 4 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 5 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 5 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 1 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = olympus_mons } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 2 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hellas_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 3 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = utopia_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 4 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = arcadia_planitia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 5 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 4 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 6 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ceres } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 6 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 7 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = vesta } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 7 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 8 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = psyche } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 8 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 9 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pallas } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 9 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 10 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hygiea } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 10 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ceres } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 6 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = vesta } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 7 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = psyche } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 8 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = pallas } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 9 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = hygiea } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 10 } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 5 }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 11 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = io } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 11 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 12 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = europa } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 12 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 13 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = ganymede } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 13 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 14 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = callisto } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 14 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 15 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = himalia } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 15 } }
			if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next = 0 local_var:sr_fl_tgt < 16 sr_site_hostile_target = { KEY = amalthea } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 16 } }

		limit = { local_var:sr_fl_next > 0 }

		if = { limit = { sr_fl_$N$_posture_value = 3 } sr_fl_charge_free_at = { N = $N$ } }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target }
		remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target
	}
}

# The interdiction's step (6c; Interdict's target, sr_fl_set_posture_at, and the
# console's): the next world at the slot's location it may interdict, else the
# first; none ends the interdiction (it stands off).
# Never at Earth (lunar colonization § 8.3).
sr_fl_step_icpt_target_at = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_tgt value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_tgt value = var:sr_fl_$N$_target } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_next value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc }

# Interdicting the target world's holder begins its price (sr_cb_charge_interdict),
# once per fleet and target; checked monthly (sr_cb_check_icpt).
sr_fl_charge_icpt_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 1 }
		sr_cb_charge_interdict = { N = $N$ KEY = valles_marineris }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 2 }
		sr_cb_charge_interdict = { N = $N$ KEY = olympus_mons }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 3 }
		sr_cb_charge_interdict = { N = $N$ KEY = hellas_planitia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 4 }
		sr_cb_charge_interdict = { N = $N$ KEY = utopia_planitia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 5 }
		sr_cb_charge_interdict = { N = $N$ KEY = arcadia_planitia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 6 }
		sr_cb_charge_interdict = { N = $N$ KEY = ceres }
	}

sr_fl_check_icpt_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target } }
		sr_fl_end_icpt = { N = $N$ }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 1 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = valles_marineris }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 2 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = olympus_mons }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 3 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = hellas_planitia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 4 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = utopia_planitia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 5 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = arcadia_planitia }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 6 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = ceres }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 7 }
		sr_cb_check_icpt = { N = $N$ KEY = vesta }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_target = 8 }

# Country scope: our interdiction lists (sr_icpt_<loc>, the countries our
# fleets interdict at each location), rebuilt from every interdicting slot with
# the location records (sr_loc_rebuild) and on every posture or target order.
sr_icpt_rebuild = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_icpt_inner } clear_variable_list = sr_icpt_inner }
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_icpt_mars } clear_variable_list = sr_icpt_mars }
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_icpt_asteroids } clear_variable_list = sr_icpt_asteroids }
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_icpt_jupiter } clear_variable_list = sr_icpt_jupiter }
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_icpt_saturn } clear_variable_list = sr_icpt_saturn }
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_icpt_uranus } clear_variable_list = sr_icpt_uranus }
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_icpt_neptune } clear_variable_list = sr_icpt_neptune }
	if = { limit = { has_variable_list = sr_icpt_kuiper } clear_variable_list = sr_icpt_kuiper }
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc has_variable = sr_fl_1_target sr_fl_1_posture_value = 4 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 var:sr_fl_1_target = 1 }
			sr_icpt_note = { KEY = valles_marineris LOC = mars }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 var:sr_fl_1_target = 2 }
			sr_icpt_note = { KEY = olympus_mons LOC = mars }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 var:sr_fl_1_target = 3 }
			sr_icpt_note = { KEY = hellas_planitia LOC = mars }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 var:sr_fl_1_target = 4 }
			sr_icpt_note = { KEY = utopia_planitia LOC = mars }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 3 var:sr_fl_1_target = 5 }
			sr_icpt_note = { KEY = arcadia_planitia LOC = mars }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_1_loc = 4 var:sr_fl_1_target = 6 }
			sr_icpt_note = { KEY = ceres LOC = asteroids }

sr_cb_clear_earth = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_present } remove_variable = sr_cb_present }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s1 } remove_variable = sr_cb_s1 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s2 } remove_variable = sr_cb_s2 }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3 } remove_variable = sr_cb_s3 }

sr_cb_world_sums_earth = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_shackleton value = sr_cb_closing_shackleton }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_peary value = sr_cb_closing_peary }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_tranquility value = sr_cb_closing_tranquility }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_marius_hills value = sr_cb_closing_marius_hills }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_daedalus value = sr_cb_closing_daedalus }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_imbrium value = sr_cb_closing_imbrium }
}
sr_cb_world_clear_earth = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_shackleton } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_shackleton }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_peary } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_peary }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_tranquility } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_tranquility }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_marius_hills } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_marius_hills }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_daedalus } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_daedalus }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_imbrium } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_imbrium }
}
# The power's losses to each world's Defences, by its share of the strength
# closing in on it (on the Moon and Mars, on any colony of its holder's
# there, whose Defences are shared: sr_cb_c_shared_<key>).
sr_cb_def_losses_earth = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_shackleton has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_shackleton global_var:sr_cb_c_shackleton > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_shackleton value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_shackleton multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_shackleton divide = sr_cb_c_shared_shackleton } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_peary has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_peary global_var:sr_cb_c_peary > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_peary value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_peary multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_peary divide = sr_cb_c_shared_peary } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_tranquility has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_tranquility global_var:sr_cb_c_tranquility > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_tranquility value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_tranquility multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_tranquility divide = sr_cb_c_shared_tranquility } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_marius_hills has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_marius_hills global_var:sr_cb_c_marius_hills > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_marius_hills value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_marius_hills multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_marius_hills divide = sr_cb_c_shared_marius_hills } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_daedalus has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_daedalus global_var:sr_cb_c_daedalus > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_daedalus value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_daedalus multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_daedalus divide = sr_cb_c_shared_daedalus } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_imbrium has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_imbrium global_var:sr_cb_c_imbrium > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_imbrium value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_imbrium multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_imbrium divide = sr_cb_c_shared_imbrium } }
	}
}

	sr_site_assault_step = { KEY = shackleton INDEX = 35 }
	sr_site_lunar_blockade_step = { KEY = shackleton }
	sr_site_assault_step = { KEY = peary INDEX = 36 }

		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_utopia_planitia value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_utopia_planitia multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_utopia_planitia divide = sr_cb_c_shared_utopia_planitia } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_arcadia_planitia has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_arcadia_planitia global_var:sr_cb_c_arcadia_planitia > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_arcadia_planitia value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_arcadia_planitia multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_arcadia_planitia divide = sr_cb_c_shared_arcadia_planitia } }
	}
}

sr_cb_world_sums_asteroids = {
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_ceres value = sr_cb_closing_ceres }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_vesta value = sr_cb_closing_vesta }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_psyche value = sr_cb_closing_psyche }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_pallas value = sr_cb_closing_pallas }
	set_global_variable = { name = sr_cb_c_hygiea value = sr_cb_closing_hygiea }
}
sr_cb_world_clear_asteroids = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_ceres } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_ceres }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_vesta } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_vesta }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_psyche } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_psyche }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_pallas } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_pallas }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_hygiea } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_hygiea }
}
# The power's losses to each world's Defences, by its share of the strength
# closing in on it (on the Moon and Mars, on any colony of its holder's
# there, whose Defences are shared: sr_cb_c_shared_<key>).
sr_cb_def_losses_asteroids = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_ceres has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_ceres global_var:sr_cb_c_ceres > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_ceres value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_ceres multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_ceres divide = sr_cb_c_shared_ceres } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_vesta has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_vesta global_var:sr_cb_c_vesta > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_vesta value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_vesta multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_vesta divide = sr_cb_c_shared_vesta } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_psyche has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_psyche global_var:sr_cb_c_psyche > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_psyche value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_psyche multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_psyche divide = sr_cb_c_shared_psyche } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_pallas has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_pallas global_var:sr_cb_c_pallas > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_pallas value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_pallas multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_pallas divide = sr_cb_c_shared_pallas } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_hygiea has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_hygiea global_var:sr_cb_c_hygiea > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_hygiea value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_hygiea multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_hygiea divide = sr_cb_c_shared_hygiea } }
	}
}

		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_enceladus has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_enceladus global_var:sr_cb_c_enceladus > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_enceladus value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_enceladus multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_enceladus divide = sr_cb_c_shared_enceladus } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_rhea has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_rhea global_var:sr_cb_c_rhea > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_rhea value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_rhea multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_rhea divide = sr_cb_c_shared_rhea } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_mimas has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_mimas global_var:sr_cb_c_mimas > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_mimas value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_mimas multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_mimas divide = sr_cb_c_shared_mimas } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_iapetus has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_iapetus global_var:sr_cb_c_iapetus > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_iapetus value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_iapetus multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_iapetus divide = sr_cb_c_shared_iapetus } }
	}
}

	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_oberon } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_oberon }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_miranda } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_miranda }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_ariel } remove_global_variable = sr_cb_c_ariel }
}
# The power's losses to each world's Defences, by its share of the strength
# closing in on it (on the Moon and Mars, on any colony of its holder's
# there, whose Defences are shared: sr_cb_c_shared_<key>).
sr_cb_def_losses_uranus = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_titania has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_titania global_var:sr_cb_c_titania > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_titania value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_titania multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_titania divide = sr_cb_c_shared_titania } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_oberon has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_oberon global_var:sr_cb_c_oberon > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_oberon value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_oberon multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_oberon divide = sr_cb_c_shared_oberon } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_miranda has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_miranda global_var:sr_cb_c_miranda > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_miranda value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_miranda multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_miranda divide = sr_cb_c_shared_miranda } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_cb_s3_ariel has_global_variable = sr_cb_c_ariel global_var:sr_cb_c_ariel > 0 }
		set_variable = { name = sr_cb_ld_ariel value = { value = sr_site_def_fire_ariel multiply = sr_fleet_k multiply = var:sr_cb_s3_ariel divide = sr_cb_c_shared_ariel } }
	}
}

# The seizer's marines spent at the world (local_var:sr_cb_pay), from its slots
# closing in on it to seize, in slot order.
sr_fl_spend_marines_valles_marineris = {
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_cb_pay > 0 has_variable = sr_fl_1_target var:sr_fl_1_target = 1 sr_fl_1_posture_value = 3 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_destroy } sr_fl_1_marines_value > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_take value = { value = sr_fl_1_marines_value max = local_var:sr_cb_pay } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_1_marines subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_pay subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_cb_pay > 0 has_variable = sr_fl_2_target var:sr_fl_2_target = 1 sr_fl_2_posture_value = 3 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_destroy } sr_fl_2_marines_value > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_take value = { value = sr_fl_2_marines_value max = local_var:sr_cb_pay } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_2_marines subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_pay subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_cb_pay > 0 has_variable = sr_fl_3_target var:sr_fl_3_target = 1 sr_fl_3_posture_value = 3 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_destroy } sr_fl_3_marines_value > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_take value = { value = sr_fl_3_marines_value max = local_var:sr_cb_pay } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_3_marines subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_pay subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_cb_pay > 0 has_variable = sr_fl_4_target var:sr_fl_4_target = 1 sr_fl_4_posture_value = 3 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_destroy } sr_fl_4_marines_value > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_take value = { value = sr_fl_4_marines_value max = local_var:sr_cb_pay } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_4_marines subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_pay subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_cb_pay > 0 has_variable = sr_fl_5_target var:sr_fl_5_target = 1 sr_fl_5_posture_value = 3 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_destroy } sr_fl_5_marines_value > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_take value = { value = sr_fl_5_marines_value max = local_var:sr_cb_pay } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_5_marines subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_pay subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_cb_pay > 0 has_variable = sr_fl_6_target var:sr_fl_6_target = 1 sr_fl_6_posture_value = 3 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_destroy } sr_fl_6_marines_value > 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_take value = { value = sr_fl_6_marines_value max = local_var:sr_cb_pay } }
		change_variable = { name = sr_fl_6_marines subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_cb_pay subtract = local_var:sr_cb_take }

# The holder's marines that defended the world as it falls to an occupier
# (sr_site_occupy, before the occupier is set): its own and, on the Moon and Mars,
# those at the holder's other colonies there, which defend it (owner, 2026-11-24).
sr_site_lose_shared_marines_valles_marineris = {
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_marines_olympus_mons sr_site_shares = { A = valles_marineris B = olympus_mons } } remove_global_variable = sr_site_marines_olympus_mons }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_marines_hellas_planitia sr_site_shares = { A = valles_marineris B = hellas_planitia } } remove_global_variable = sr_site_marines_hellas_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_marines_utopia_planitia sr_site_shares = { A = valles_marineris B = utopia_planitia } } remove_global_variable = sr_site_marines_utopia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_marines_arcadia_planitia sr_site_shares = { A = valles_marineris B = arcadia_planitia } } remove_global_variable = sr_site_marines_arcadia_planitia }
	if = { limit = { has_global_variable = sr_site_marines_valles_marineris } remove_global_variable = sr_site_marines_valles_marineris }
}

# ===== The battle (2026-11-25 design § 2; sr_fleet_combat_effects.txt's sr_battle_at) =====
# A slot's battle figures cleared, after each battle (BT_VARS).
sr_fl_bt_end_at = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_in } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_in }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_pace } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_pace }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_eng } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_eng }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_tied } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_tied }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_brought } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_brought }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_s } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_s }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_f } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_f }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_r } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_r }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_p } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_p }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_l } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_l }
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_broke } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_broke }
}
# A broken fleet not at a dock leaves for the nearest it may depart for (§ 2.4):
# Earth, or a location where we hold a Spaceport, nearest by the leg's quarters,
# through the same sr_fl_<n>_may_depart_<loc> an order passes. With none in
# reach it stays, out of this battle, and can be caught at the next tick.
sr_fl_retreat_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_bt_broke NOT = { sr_fl_$N$_docked = yes } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_best value = 999999 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_to value = 0 }
		if = {
			limit = { sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_earth = yes sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_earth < local_var:sr_bt_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_best value = sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_earth }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_to value = 1 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_loc_port_inner = yes sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_inner = yes sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_inner < local_var:sr_bt_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_best value = sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_inner }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_to value = 2 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_loc_port_mars = yes sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_mars = yes sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_mars < local_var:sr_bt_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_best value = sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_mars }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_to value = 3 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_loc_port_asteroids = yes sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_asteroids = yes sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_asteroids < local_var:sr_bt_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_best value = sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_asteroids }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_to value = 4 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_loc_port_jupiter = yes sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_jupiter = yes sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_jupiter < local_var:sr_bt_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_best value = sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_jupiter }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_to value = 5 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_loc_port_saturn = yes sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_saturn = yes sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_saturn < local_var:sr_bt_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_best value = sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_saturn }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_to value = 6 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_loc_port_uranus = yes sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_uranus = yes sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_uranus < local_var:sr_bt_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_best value = sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_uranus }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_to value = 7 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_loc_port_neptune = yes sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_neptune = yes sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_neptune < local_var:sr_bt_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_best value = sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_neptune }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_to value = 8 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { sr_loc_port_kuiper = yes sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_kuiper = yes sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_kuiper < local_var:sr_bt_best }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_best value = sr_fl_$N$_leg_quarters_kuiper }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_bt_to value = 9 }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_bt_to = 1 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_earth = yes }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = earth CODE = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_bt_to = 2 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_inner = yes }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = inner CODE = 2 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_bt_to = 3 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_mars = yes }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = mars CODE = 3 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_bt_to = 4 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_bt_to = 5 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_jupiter = yes }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = jupiter CODE = 5 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_bt_to = 6 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_saturn = yes }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = saturn CODE = 6 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_bt_to = 7 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_uranus = yes }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = uranus CODE = 7 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_bt_to = 8 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_neptune = yes }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = neptune CODE = 8 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_bt_to = 9 sr_fl_$N$_may_depart_kuiper = yes }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = $N$ LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
		}
	}
}

# ===== The AI's defence (6b; sr_fl_ai_defend; its win test, 2026-11-25 design § 2.7) =====
sr_fl_ai_defend_all = {
	sr_fl_ai_defend_inner = yes
	sr_fl_ai_defend_mars = yes
	sr_fl_ai_defend_asteroids = yes
	sr_fl_ai_defend_jupiter = yes
	sr_fl_ai_defend_saturn = yes
	sr_fl_ai_defend_uranus = yes
	sr_fl_ai_defend_neptune = yes
	sr_fl_ai_defend_kuiper = yes
}
# Slot N's strength and fire, at the location in local_var:sr_fl_code or on its
# way there: a hostile's (sr_fl_ts, _tf) and ours (sr_fl_os, _of).
sr_fl_ai_threat_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = local_var:sr_fl_code } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc } has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_dest var:sr_fl_$N$_dest = local_var:sr_fl_code } } }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ts add = sr_fl_$N$_strength }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_tf add = { value = sr_fl_$N$_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
	}
}
sr_fl_ai_guard_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { OR = { AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = local_var:sr_fl_code } AND = { NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc } has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_dest var:sr_fl_$N$_dest = local_var:sr_fl_code } } }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_os add = sr_fl_$N$_strength }
		change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_of add = { value = sr_fl_$N$_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
	}
}
sr_fl_ai_defend_inner = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes }
		save_temporary_scope_as = sr_icpt_victim
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_code value = 2 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ts value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_tf value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_os value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_of value = 0 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes OR = { has_war_with = scope:sr_icpt_victim sr_icpt_interdicts_at = { LOC = inner } } }
			sr_fl_each_slot = { DO = ai_threat }
		}
		sr_fl_each_slot = { DO = ai_guard }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_need value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_ts multiply = local_var:sr_fl_tf multiply = sr_fl_ai_engage_margin } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_have value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_os multiply = local_var:sr_fl_of } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { local_var:sr_fl_os <= 0 local_var:sr_fl_have < local_var:sr_fl_need } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_s value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_f value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cnt value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_earth_threat value = 0 }
			if = { limit = { sr_fl_ai_earth_threatened = yes } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_earth_threat value = 1 } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_1 value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_2 value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_3 value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_4 value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_5 value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_6 value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_7 value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_8 value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_9 value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_fl_1_may_depart_inner = yes sr_fl_1_ai_free = yes sr_fl_1_ai_reaches_inner = yes NOT = { AND = { local_var:sr_fl_earth_threat = 1 sr_fl_1_at_earth = yes } } }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_1 value = 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_s add = sr_fl_1_strength }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_f add = { value = sr_fl_1_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cnt add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_fl_1_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_1_strength }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_1_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { sr_fl_2_may_depart_inner = yes sr_fl_2_ai_free = yes sr_fl_2_ai_reaches_inner = yes NOT = { AND = { local_var:sr_fl_earth_threat = 1 sr_fl_2_at_earth = yes } } }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_2 value = 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_s add = sr_fl_2_strength }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_f add = { value = sr_fl_2_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cnt add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_fl_2_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_2_strength }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_2_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 2 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { sr_fl_3_may_depart_inner = yes sr_fl_3_ai_free = yes sr_fl_3_ai_reaches_inner = yes NOT = { AND = { local_var:sr_fl_earth_threat = 1 sr_fl_3_at_earth = yes } } }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_3 value = 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_s add = sr_fl_3_strength }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_f add = { value = sr_fl_3_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }

					change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_os add = local_var:sr_fl_best }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_of add = local_var:sr_fl_bf }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 1 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_1 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 2 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_2 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 3 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_3 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 4 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_4 value = 2 } }

					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 8 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_8 value = 2 } }

				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_5 = 2 sr_fl_5_may_depart_inner = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 5 LOC = inner CODE = 2 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_6 = 2 sr_fl_6_may_depart_inner = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 6 LOC = inner CODE = 2 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_7 = 2 sr_fl_7_may_depart_inner = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 7 LOC = inner CODE = 2 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_8 = 2 sr_fl_8_may_depart_inner = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 8 LOC = inner CODE = 2 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_9 = 2 sr_fl_9_may_depart_inner = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 9 LOC = inner CODE = 2 } }

		}
	}
}

	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes }
		save_temporary_scope_as = sr_icpt_victim
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_code value = 3 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ts value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_tf value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_os value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_of value = 0 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes OR = { has_war_with = scope:sr_icpt_victim sr_icpt_interdicts_at = { LOC = mars } } }
			sr_fl_each_slot = { DO = ai_threat }
		}
		sr_fl_each_slot = { DO = ai_guard }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_need value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_ts multiply = local_var:sr_fl_tf multiply = sr_fl_ai_engage_margin } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_have value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_os multiply = local_var:sr_fl_of } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { local_var:sr_fl_os <= 0 local_var:sr_fl_have < local_var:sr_fl_need } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = 0 }

					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_5_strength }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_5_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 5 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { sr_fl_6_may_depart_mars = yes sr_fl_6_ai_free = yes sr_fl_6_ai_reaches_mars = yes NOT = { AND = { local_var:sr_fl_earth_threat = 1 sr_fl_6_at_earth = yes } } }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_6 value = 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_s add = sr_fl_6_strength }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_f add = { value = sr_fl_6_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cnt add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_fl_6_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_6_strength }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_6_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 6 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { sr_fl_7_may_depart_mars = yes sr_fl_7_ai_free = yes sr_fl_7_ai_reaches_mars = yes NOT = { AND = { local_var:sr_fl_earth_threat = 1 sr_fl_7_at_earth = yes } } }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_7 value = 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_s add = sr_fl_7_strength }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_f add = { value = sr_fl_7_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cnt add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_fl_7_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_7_strength }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_7_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 7 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { sr_fl_8_may_depart_mars = yes sr_fl_8_ai_free = yes sr_fl_8_ai_reaches_mars = yes NOT = { AND = { local_var:sr_fl_earth_threat = 1 sr_fl_8_at_earth = yes } } }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_8 value = 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_s add = sr_fl_8_strength }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_f add = { value = sr_fl_8_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cnt add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_fl_8_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_8_strength }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_8_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 8 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { sr_fl_9_may_depart_mars = yes sr_fl_9_ai_free = yes sr_fl_9_ai_reaches_mars = yes NOT = { AND = { local_var:sr_fl_earth_threat = 1 sr_fl_9_at_earth = yes } } }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_9 value = 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_s add = sr_fl_9_strength }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_f add = { value = sr_fl_9_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cnt add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_fl_9_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_9_strength }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_9_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 9 }
				}
			}
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_win1 value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_os add = local_var:sr_fl_best multiply = { value = local_var:sr_fl_of add = local_var:sr_fl_bf } } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_win_all value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_os add = local_var:sr_fl_all_s multiply = { value = local_var:sr_fl_of add = local_var:sr_fl_all_f } } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n > 0 local_var:sr_fl_win1 >= local_var:sr_fl_need }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 1 sr_fl_1_may_depart_mars = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 1 LOC = mars CODE = 3 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 2 sr_fl_2_may_depart_mars = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 2 LOC = mars CODE = 3 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 3 sr_fl_3_may_depart_mars = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 3 LOC = mars CODE = 3 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 4 sr_fl_4_may_depart_mars = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 4 LOC = mars CODE = 3 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 5 sr_fl_5_may_depart_mars = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 5 LOC = mars CODE = 3 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 6 sr_fl_6_may_depart_mars = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 6 LOC = mars CODE = 3 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 7 sr_fl_7_may_depart_mars = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 7 LOC = mars CODE = 3 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 8 sr_fl_8_may_depart_mars = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 8 LOC = mars CODE = 3 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 9 sr_fl_9_may_depart_mars = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 9 LOC = mars CODE = 3 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_fl_cnt > 1 local_var:sr_fl_win_all >= local_var:sr_fl_need }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 1 }
				while = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n > 0 local_var:sr_fl_have < local_var:sr_fl_need }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = 0 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = 0 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_1 = 1 sr_fl_1_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_1_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_1_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 1 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_2 = 1 sr_fl_2_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_2_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_2_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_3 = 1 sr_fl_3_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_3_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_3_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 3 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_4 = 1 sr_fl_4_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_4_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_4_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 4 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_5 = 1 sr_fl_5_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_5_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_5_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 5 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_6 = 1 sr_fl_6_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_6_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_6_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 6 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_7 = 1 sr_fl_7_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_7_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_7_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 7 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_8 = 1 sr_fl_8_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_8_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_8_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 8 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_9 = 1 sr_fl_9_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_9_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_9_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 9 } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_os add = local_var:sr_fl_best }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_of add = local_var:sr_fl_bf }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 1 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_1 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 2 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_2 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 3 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_3 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 4 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_4 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 5 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_5 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 6 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_6 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 7 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_7 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 8 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_8 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 9 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_9 value = 2 } }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_have value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_os multiply = local_var:sr_fl_of } }
				}
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_1 = 2 sr_fl_1_may_depart_mars = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 1 LOC = mars CODE = 3 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_2 = 2 sr_fl_2_may_depart_mars = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 2 LOC = mars CODE = 3 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_3 = 2 sr_fl_3_may_depart_mars = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 3 LOC = mars CODE = 3 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_4 = 2 sr_fl_4_may_depart_mars = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 4 LOC = mars CODE = 3 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_5 = 2 sr_fl_5_may_depart_mars = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 5 LOC = mars CODE = 3 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_6 = 2 sr_fl_6_may_depart_mars = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 6 LOC = mars CODE = 3 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_7 = 2 sr_fl_7_may_depart_mars = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 7 LOC = mars CODE = 3 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_8 = 2 sr_fl_8_may_depart_mars = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 8 LOC = mars CODE = 3 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_9 = 2 sr_fl_9_may_depart_mars = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 9 LOC = mars CODE = 3 } }
			}
		}
	}
}
sr_fl_ai_defend_asteroids = {
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_asteroids = yes }
		save_temporary_scope_as = sr_icpt_victim
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_code value = 4 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ts value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_tf value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_os value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_of value = 0 }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes OR = { has_war_with = scope:sr_icpt_victim sr_icpt_interdicts_at = { LOC = asteroids } } }
			sr_fl_each_slot = { DO = ai_threat }
		}
		sr_fl_each_slot = { DO = ai_guard }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_need value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_ts multiply = local_var:sr_fl_tf multiply = sr_fl_ai_engage_margin } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_have value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_os multiply = local_var:sr_fl_of } }
		if = {
			limit = { OR = { local_var:sr_fl_os <= 0 local_var:sr_fl_have < local_var:sr_fl_need } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = 0 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = 0 }

				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cnt add = 1 }

					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 7 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { sr_fl_8_may_depart_asteroids = yes sr_fl_8_ai_free = yes sr_fl_8_ai_reaches_asteroids = yes NOT = { AND = { local_var:sr_fl_earth_threat = 1 sr_fl_8_at_earth = yes } } }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_8 value = 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_s add = sr_fl_8_strength }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_f add = { value = sr_fl_8_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cnt add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_fl_8_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_8_strength }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_8_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 8 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { sr_fl_9_may_depart_asteroids = yes sr_fl_9_ai_free = yes sr_fl_9_ai_reaches_asteroids = yes NOT = { AND = { local_var:sr_fl_earth_threat = 1 sr_fl_9_at_earth = yes } } }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_9 value = 1 }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_s add = sr_fl_9_strength }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_all_f add = { value = sr_fl_9_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
				change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_cnt add = 1 }
				if = {
					limit = { sr_fl_9_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_9_strength }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_9_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 9 }
				}
			}
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_win1 value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_os add = local_var:sr_fl_best multiply = { value = local_var:sr_fl_of add = local_var:sr_fl_bf } } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_win_all value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_os add = local_var:sr_fl_all_s multiply = { value = local_var:sr_fl_of add = local_var:sr_fl_all_f } } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n > 0 local_var:sr_fl_win1 >= local_var:sr_fl_need }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 1 sr_fl_1_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 1 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 2 sr_fl_2_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 2 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 3 sr_fl_3_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 3 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 4 sr_fl_4_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 4 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 5 sr_fl_5_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 5 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 6 sr_fl_6_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 6 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 7 sr_fl_7_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 7 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 8 sr_fl_8_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 8 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 9 sr_fl_9_may_depart_asteroids = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 9 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 }
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_fl_cnt > 1 local_var:sr_fl_win_all >= local_var:sr_fl_need }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 1 }
				while = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n > 0 local_var:sr_fl_have < local_var:sr_fl_need }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = 0 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = 0 }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 0 }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_1 = 1 sr_fl_1_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_1_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_1_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 1 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_2 = 1 sr_fl_2_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_2_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_2_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_3 = 1 sr_fl_3_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_3_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_3_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 3 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_4 = 1 sr_fl_4_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_4_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_4_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 4 } }

					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_7 = 1 sr_fl_7_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_7_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_7_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 7 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_8 = 1 sr_fl_8_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_8_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_8_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 8 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_9 = 1 sr_fl_9_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_9_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_bf value = { value = sr_fl_9_fire_fleets multiply = sr_fleet_quality multiply = sr_fleet_readiness } } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 9 } }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_os add = local_var:sr_fl_best }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_of add = local_var:sr_fl_bf }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 1 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_1 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 2 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_2 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 3 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_3 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 4 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_4 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 5 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_5 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 6 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_6 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 7 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_7 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 8 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_8 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 9 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_9 value = 2 } }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_have value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_os multiply = local_var:sr_fl_of } }
				}
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_1 = 2 sr_fl_1_may_depart_asteroids = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 1 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_2 = 2 sr_fl_2_may_depart_asteroids = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 2 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_3 = 2 sr_fl_3_may_depart_asteroids = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 3 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_4 = 2 sr_fl_4_may_depart_asteroids = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 4 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_5 = 2 sr_fl_5_may_depart_asteroids = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 5 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_6 = 2 sr_fl_6_may_depart_asteroids = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 6 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_7 = 2 sr_fl_7_may_depart_asteroids = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 7 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_8 = 2 sr_fl_8_may_depart_asteroids = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 8 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_9 = 2 sr_fl_9_may_depart_asteroids = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 9 LOC = asteroids CODE = 4 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

			}
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_win1 value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_os add = local_var:sr_fl_best multiply = { value = local_var:sr_fl_of add = local_var:sr_fl_bf } } }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_win_all value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_os add = local_var:sr_fl_all_s multiply = { value = local_var:sr_fl_of add = local_var:sr_fl_all_f } } }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n > 0 local_var:sr_fl_win1 >= local_var:sr_fl_need }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 1 sr_fl_1_may_depart_jupiter = yes }
					sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 1 LOC = jupiter CODE = 5 }
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 2 sr_fl_2_may_depart_jupiter = yes }

				}
			}

				limit = { local_var:sr_fl_cnt > 1 local_var:sr_fl_win_all >= local_var:sr_fl_need }

					limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n > 0 local_var:sr_fl_have < local_var:sr_fl_need }

					change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_os add = local_var:sr_fl_best }
					change_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_of add = local_var:sr_fl_bf }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 1 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_1 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 2 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_2 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 3 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_3 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 4 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_4 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 5 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_5 value = 2 } }

					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 7 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_7 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 8 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_8 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 9 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_9 value = 2 } }

				}

				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_3 = 2 sr_fl_3_may_depart_jupiter = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 3 LOC = jupiter CODE = 5 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_4 = 2 sr_fl_4_may_depart_jupiter = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 4 LOC = jupiter CODE = 5 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_5 = 2 sr_fl_5_may_depart_jupiter = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 5 LOC = jupiter CODE = 5 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_6 = 2 sr_fl_6_may_depart_jupiter = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 6 LOC = jupiter CODE = 5 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_7 = 2 sr_fl_7_may_depart_jupiter = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 7 LOC = jupiter CODE = 5 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_8 = 2 sr_fl_8_may_depart_jupiter = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 8 LOC = jupiter CODE = 5 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_9 = 2 sr_fl_9_may_depart_jupiter = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 9 LOC = jupiter CODE = 5 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_9 = 2 sr_fl_9_may_depart_saturn = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 9 LOC = saturn CODE = 6 } }

		}
	}
