					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 8 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_8 value = 2 } }
					if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 9 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_el_9 value = 2 } }
					set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_have value = { value = local_var:sr_fl_os multiply = local_var:sr_fl_of } }
				}
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_1 = 2 sr_fl_1_may_depart_kuiper = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 1 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_2 = 2 sr_fl_2_may_depart_kuiper = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 2 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_3 = 2 sr_fl_3_may_depart_kuiper = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 3 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_4 = 2 sr_fl_4_may_depart_kuiper = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 4 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_5 = 2 sr_fl_5_may_depart_kuiper = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 5 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_6 = 2 sr_fl_6_may_depart_kuiper = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 6 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_7 = 2 sr_fl_7_may_depart_kuiper = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 7 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_8 = 2 sr_fl_8_may_depart_kuiper = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 8 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 } }
				if = { limit = { local_var:sr_fl_el_9 = 2 sr_fl_9_may_depart_kuiper = yes } sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 9 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 } }
			}
		}
	}
}

# ===== The AI's offence (6c; sr_fl_ai_attack, sr_fleet_combat_effects.txt) =====
# One order a month at most: to the first location (table order) with a world
# it may attack and none of its fleets there or on the way, the strongest of
# its docked fleets free of the defence that reaches and outmatches it
# (sr_fl_<n>_ai_attacks_<loc>).

			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 4 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 4 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 5 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 5 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 6 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 6 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 7 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 7 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 8 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 8 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 9 }
			sr_fl_dispatch = { N = 9 LOC = kuiper CODE = 9 }
			set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_ai_sent value = 1 }
		}
	}
}

# Lunar colonization § 8.4: at war, while no enemy's fleet is at Earth
# (sr_earth_hostile_present: a stationed one bars the seizure, sr_cb_seizes),
# first the enemy's lunar world of most worth (sr_site_ai_worth_<key>) that
# passes sr_site_ai_lunar_target, then the strongest of its fleets at Earth
# whose marines exceed that world's garrison and militia closes in on it to
# seize it; every other fleet of ours at Earth stays stationed (with none to
# close in, all of them). Never to destroy. Before the offence's dispatch,
# which leaves a fleet closing in at Earth where it is.
sr_fl_ai_lunar_assault = {
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = -1 }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { sr_earth_hostile_present = yes } }
		if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_lunar_target = { KEY = shackleton } sr_site_ai_worth_shackleton > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_shackleton } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 35 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_shackleton } }
		if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_lunar_target = { KEY = peary } sr_site_ai_worth_peary > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_peary } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 36 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_peary } }
		if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_lunar_target = { KEY = tranquility } sr_site_ai_worth_tranquility > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_tranquility } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 37 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_tranquility } }
		if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_lunar_target = { KEY = marius_hills } sr_site_ai_worth_marius_hills > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_marius_hills } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 38 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_marius_hills } }
		if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_lunar_target = { KEY = daedalus } sr_site_ai_worth_daedalus > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_daedalus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 39 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_daedalus } }
		if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_lunar_target = { KEY = imbrium } sr_site_ai_worth_imbrium > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_imbrium } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 40 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_imbrium } }
	}
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = 0 }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { local_var:sr_ai_tgt > 0 }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_1_at_earth = yes sr_fl_1_marines_eff > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_1_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_1_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_2_at_earth = yes sr_fl_2_marines_eff > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_2_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_2_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 2 } }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_3_at_earth = yes sr_fl_3_marines_eff > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_3_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_3_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 3 } }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_4_at_earth = yes sr_fl_4_marines_eff > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_4_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_4_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 4 } }
		if = { limit = { sr_fl_5_at_earth = yes sr_fl_5_marines_eff > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_5_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_5_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 5 } }

		if = { limit = { sr_fl_9_at_earth = yes sr_fl_9_marines_eff > local_var:sr_ai_need sr_fl_9_strength > local_var:sr_fl_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_best value = sr_fl_9_strength } set_local_variable = { name = sr_fl_n value = 9 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_1_at_earth = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_destroy } remove_variable = sr_fl_1_destroy }
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_fl_n = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_1_posture value = 3 }
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_1_target value = local_var:sr_ai_tgt }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = sr_fl_1_posture value = 1 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_target } remove_variable = sr_fl_1_target }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { sr_fl_2_at_earth = yes }
		if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_destroy } remove_variable = sr_fl_2_destroy }

# A slot at a location where we hold no threatened colony and there is a world
# it may attack: it closes in on the one of most worth (sr_site_ai_worth_<key>)
# to seize it when its marines exceed the world's garrison and militia, else it
# stands off and blockades. Never to destroy (design § 14).
sr_fl_ai_assault_at = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_loc NOT = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 1 } }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = 0 }
		set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = -1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 2 NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_inner = yes } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = venus } sr_site_ai_worth_venus > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_venus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 17 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_venus } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = mercury } sr_site_ai_worth_mercury > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_mercury } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 18 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_mercury } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 3 NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_mars = yes } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = valles_marineris } sr_site_ai_worth_valles_marineris > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_valles_marineris } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 1 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_valles_marineris } }

			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 7 NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_uranus = yes } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = titania } sr_site_ai_worth_titania > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_titania } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 24 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_titania } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = oberon } sr_site_ai_worth_oberon > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_oberon } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 25 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_oberon } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = miranda } sr_site_ai_worth_miranda > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_miranda } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 26 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_miranda } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = ariel } sr_site_ai_worth_ariel > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_ariel } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 27 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_ariel } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 8 NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_neptune = yes } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = triton } sr_site_ai_worth_triton > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_triton } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 28 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_triton } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = proteus } sr_site_ai_worth_proteus > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_proteus } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 29 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_proteus } }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:sr_fl_$N$_loc = 9 NOT = { sr_fl_ai_threatened_kuiper = yes } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = pluto } sr_site_ai_worth_pluto > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_pluto } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 30 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_pluto } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = eris } sr_site_ai_worth_eris > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_eris } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 31 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_eris } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = makemake } sr_site_ai_worth_makemake > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_makemake } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 32 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_makemake } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = haumea } sr_site_ai_worth_haumea > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_haumea } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 33 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_haumea } }
			if = { limit = { sr_site_ai_attack_target = { KEY = sedna } sr_site_ai_worth_sedna > local_var:sr_ai_best } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_best value = sr_site_ai_worth_sedna } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_tgt value = 34 } set_local_variable = { name = sr_ai_need value = sr_site_assault_need_sedna } }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { local_var:sr_ai_tgt > 0 }
			if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_destroy } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_destroy }
			if = {
				limit = { sr_fl_$N$_marines_eff > local_var:sr_ai_need }
				set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 3 }
				set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_target value = local_var:sr_ai_tgt }
			}
			else = {
				set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_posture value = 2 }
				if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target } remove_variable = sr_fl_$N$_target }
			}
		}
	}
}

# Every fleet of ours in transit lands now.
sr_fl_debug_land_at = {
	if = { limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_$N$_arrive } set_variable = { name = sr_fl_$N$_arrive value = sr_fl_tick_now } }
	sr_fl_arrive_at = { N = $N$ }
}

# ===== The colonization overview's Defense list (audit SPC-6; display only) =====
sr_ov_list_defense = {
	if = { limit = { sr_earth_blockaded = yes } custom_tooltip = je_space_race_widget_ovc_def_line_earth }
	if = { limit = { sr_launch_site_lost = yes } custom_tooltip = je_space_race_widget_ovc_def_line_site_lost }
	if = {
		limit = {
			OR = {
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_shackleton ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_shackleton }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_peary ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_peary }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_tranquility ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_tranquility }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_marius_hills ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_marius_hills }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_daedalus ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_daedalus }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_imbrium ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_imbrium }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_venus ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_venus }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mercury ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_mercury }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_valles_marineris ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_valles_marineris }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_olympus_mons ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_olympus_mons }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hellas_planitia ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_hellas_planitia }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_utopia_planitia ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_utopia_planitia }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_arcadia_planitia ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_arcadia_planitia }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ceres ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ceres }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_vesta ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_vesta }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_psyche ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_psyche }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pallas ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_pallas }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_hygiea ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_hygiea }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_io ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_io }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_europa ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_europa }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ganymede ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ganymede }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_callisto ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_callisto }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_himalia ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_himalia }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_amalthea ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_amalthea }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titan ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_titan }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_enceladus ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_enceladus }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_rhea ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_rhea }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_mimas ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_mimas }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_iapetus }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_titania }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_oberon }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_miranda }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ariel }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_triton }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_proteus ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_proteus }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_pluto }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_eris ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_eris }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_makemake }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_haumea }
				AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_sedna }
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip_no_bullet = je_space_race_widget_ovc_def_head_occupied
		if = { limit = { global_var:sr_site_holder_shackleton ?= this has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_shackleton } custom_tooltip = sr_site_name_shackleton }

					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_iapetus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_iapetus } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_iapetus }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_titania ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_titania } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_titania }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_oberon ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_oberon } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_oberon }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_miranda ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_miranda } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_miranda }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_ariel ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_ariel } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_ariel }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_triton ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_triton } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_triton }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_proteus ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_proteus } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_proteus }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_pluto ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_pluto } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_pluto }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_eris ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_eris } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_eris }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_makemake ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_makemake } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_makemake }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_haumea ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_haumea } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_haumea }
					AND = { global_var:sr_site_holder_sedna ?= this NOT = { has_global_variable = sr_site_occupier_sedna } has_global_variable = sr_site_interdicted_sedna }
				}
			}
		}
		custom_tooltip_no_bullet = je_space_race_widget_ovc_def_line_calm
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_alert_arrive var:sr_fl_alert_arrive >= sr_fl_tick_now }
		custom_tooltip_no_bullet = je_space_race_widget_ovc_def_line_inbound
	}
}

# ===== The Earth alert (UI pass design § 9), a player's, each tick (sr_fl_tick_alerts) =====
# Each hostile fleet in flight to Earth, once per leg: loud (.111) while a
# landing would tip the balance at Earth (sr_earth_alert_loud, read once: it
# reads the location records and the fleets' strengths, which nothing here
# changes), else quiet (sr_earth_hostile_notice). The players told sit on the
# fleet's sr_fl_<n>_warned_<volume> lists. One popup a tick, naming its
# fleet's owner (sr_earth_alert_by) and landing (sr_earth_alert_arrive): first
# pass, a loud fleet nobody was told of; second, the first loud one left. The
# tick's other loud fleets are marked told, and each not yet told quietly
# gets its feed notice.
sr_earth_alert_step = {
	save_scope_as = sr_alert_viewer
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud value = 0 }
	if = { limit = { sr_earth_alert_loud = yes } set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud value = 1 } }
	set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 0 }
	# First pass: the popup for a loud fleet nobody has been told of.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = sr_fleet_powers }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_war_with = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_1_dest var:sr_fl_1_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_1_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_2_dest var:sr_fl_2_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_2_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_3_dest var:sr_fl_3_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_3_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_4_dest var:sr_fl_4_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_4_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_5_dest var:sr_fl_5_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_5_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_6_dest var:sr_fl_6_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_6_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_7_dest var:sr_fl_7_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_7_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_7_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_7_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_7_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_7_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_8_dest var:sr_fl_8_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_8_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_8_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_8_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_8_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_8_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }

			}
			if = {
				limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 has_variable = sr_fl_9_dest var:sr_fl_9_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_9_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_9_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_9_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_9_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
				set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_9_arrive }
				scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
					set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
					trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	# Second pass: every other fleet bound for Earth.
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = sr_fleet_powers }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = { is_country_alive = yes has_war_with = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_dest var:sr_fl_1_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc } }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_1_arrive }
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
							trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
						add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
						save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 0 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_1_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
					scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_dest var:sr_fl_2_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc } }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					if = {

						if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }

						scope:sr_alert_viewer = {

							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
							trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
						add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
						save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 0 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_2_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
					scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_dest var:sr_fl_3_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc } }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } }

					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
						add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
						save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 0 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_3_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }

					save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
					scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_dest var:sr_fl_4_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc } }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_4_arrive }

							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
							trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
						add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
						save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 0 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_4_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
					scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_dest var:sr_fl_5_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc } }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_5_arrive }
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = {
							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_by value = prev }
							set_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arrive value = local_var:sr_earth_alert_arr }
							trigger_event = { id = space_race_events.111 days = 1 }
						}
					}
					else_if = {
						limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
						add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
						save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 0 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_5_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
					scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_dest var:sr_fl_6_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc } }
				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_alert_arr value = var:sr_fl_6_arrive }
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = {

					}

						limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
						add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
						save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
						scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 0 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_6_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					save_scope_as = sr_earth_alert_power
					scope:sr_alert_viewer = { post_notification = sr_earth_hostile_notice }
				}
			}
			if = {

				if = {
					limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud = 1 NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_7_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } }
					add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_7_warned_loud target = scope:sr_alert_viewer }
					if = {
						limit = { local_var:sr_earth_loud_sent = 0 }
						if = { limit = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_7_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } } } add_to_variable_list = { name = sr_fl_7_warned_quiet target = scope:sr_alert_viewer } }
						set_local_variable = { name = sr_earth_loud_sent value = 1 }

# The Hostile Fleet cell's hover (sr_colony_overview_sgui, op 3): a line a power
# at war with the viewer with a fleet in flight to Earth, its name and its
# sr_disp_earth_power_* (read in its scope: gui_modding_guide.md gotcha #15).
sr_ov_list_earth = {
	if = {
		limit = { has_global_variable_list = sr_fleet_powers }
		every_in_global_list = {
			variable = sr_fleet_powers
			limit = {
				is_country_alive = yes
				has_war_with = root
				OR = {
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_dest var:sr_fl_1_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_1_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_dest var:sr_fl_2_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_2_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_dest var:sr_fl_3_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_3_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_dest var:sr_fl_4_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_4_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_dest var:sr_fl_5_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_5_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_dest var:sr_fl_6_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_6_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_dest var:sr_fl_7_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_7_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_dest var:sr_fl_8_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_8_loc } }
					AND = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_dest var:sr_fl_9_dest = 1 NOT = { has_variable = sr_fl_9_loc } }
				}
			}
			custom_tooltip = je_space_race_widget_ovc_earth_line
		}
	}
}
